title: Lien Desk Q&A: Projected Overlock and Lien Notice Fees in Unit Notices under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
**The rule.** On a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the unit notice amount adds projected lien-process fees of:

- the **overlock fee**, where rent of the in-flight draft's due date is left unpaid and no past-due balance is carried, because that period opens a new delinquency whose overlock day falls before the noticed draft;
- the **lien notice fee**, where a past-due balance is carried, no lien notice fee is yet posted for the current delinquency, and the oldest unpaid due date plus the lien-notice day count falls on or before the noticed due date less the method's days before the due date its drafts run;
- otherwise **nothing**.

**Figures by unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.**

| Unit class | Overlock fee | Lien notice fee | Lien-notice day count (calendar days after the oldest unpaid due date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $25.00 | $45.00 | 35 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $25.00 | $45.00 | 35 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $25.00 | $45.00 | 35 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $25.00 | $45.00 | 35 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $30.00 | $55.00 | 40 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $30.00 | $55.00 | 45 |

**Days before the due date drafts run, by method.**

| Method | Days before the due date |
|---|---|
| Debit Card | 0 |
| Credit Card | 0 |
| Personal Checking ACH | 2 |
| Personal Savings ACH | 2 |
| Business Checking ACH | 2 |
| Business Card | 0 |

### Questions and answers

**What counts as a lien notice fee posted for the current delinquency?** A lien notice fee entry on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger whose period is the agreement's oldest unpaid due date.

**When is the lien-notice day reached?** When the oldest unpaid due date plus the class's lien-notice day count falls on or before the date the noticed draft runs (the noticed due date less the method's days before the due date). *Hypothetical, Bluegate Climate Controlled (35 days), Business Checking ACH (2 days), oldest unpaid due date 1 March:* a noticed due date of 7 April gives a draft date of 5 April, which is the 35th day after 1 March — reached; a noticed due date of 6 April gives a draft date of 4 April — not reached.

**What if a past-due balance is carried but a lien notice fee is already posted for the current delinquency?** The lien notice tier does not hold, and, since a past-due balance is carried, the overlock tier does not hold either: nothing is added.

**What if no rent of the in-flight draft's due date is left unpaid and no past-due balance is carried?** Nothing is added.

**Hypothetical amounts, Bluegate Climate Controlled:** overlock tier $25.00; lien notice tier $45.00.
